DIAGNOSIS READY: Nightmare Disorder (Sleep Disorder).

The symptoms of waking up frightened, crying, remembering the bad dreams, and returning to baseline the next day are classic for nightmare disorder rather than sleep terrors. Since you mentioned bedtime procrastination, have you noticed if these episodes happen more frequently after stressful events or when you are overtired?
